overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that wrapping a mutable default in Field(default=...) would prevent the deferred schema build from breaking attribute access on instances created by parent validators or model_construct.
why_it_breaks: When UiDiscoveryEndpoints is instantiated under concurrent load before its deferred schema is built, and WorkerRegistryEntry's schema is also not yet built, accessing the 'use_litellm_proxy' attribute on a WorkerRegistryEntry instance fails because WorkerRegistryEntry still has pydantic's MockValSer instead of a real schema, and Field(default=[]) does not trigger the model_post_init rebuild hook for the nested WorkerRegistryEntry class.
